meta.notes: Worldwide resources, the same at every installation. The Military OneSource number was supplied by the maintainer in the brief for this tool and is published on militaryonesource.mil; it is recorded here rather than generated. Re-check it against the site when revisiting this file — it is the number the toolkit falls back to when nothing local is populated, so it is the single most important value in the project.

resources.name: Military OneSource
resources.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
resources.notes: Non-medical counselling, financial counselling, and referral to the right local agency. OCONUS and international dialling options are listed on the site.
